messages:
Rae: Quick design thread — spotted in the dashboard compact experiment: action buttons and the kebab menu are colliding visually with the left checkbox column at narrow widths. Users missed the menu in the playtest.
Hector: Thanks Rae. Is this on desktop only or mobile too? Also which density token is in play?
Rae: Desktop compact. The table is using `--space-row-compact: 8px` and icons are 20px. The issue is the clickable area is ~18px which is too small.
Mei: Could we add a non-visual hit area token that increases interactive area without changing layout? Proposal: `--hitpad-compact-action: 6px` used as inner padding on the action cell so visual icon stays 20px but target becomes 32px.
Hector: Love the idea. Implementation sketch: `.action-btn { width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: var(--hitpad-compact-action); box-sizing: content-box; }` keeps icon size but grows tap target.
QA: Also noted toasts are popping beneath the sticky header and briefly cover the filter chips. Copy currently shows single words like "Removed" which is ambiguous.
Rae: Copy suggestion: adopt sentence pattern `"<Verb> <object> — Undo"` (e.g., "Removed 2 rules — Undo"). Anchor toasts to page frame bottom-right on dense list pages to avoid header overlap.
Mei: We don't have a per-page toast anchor token. Maybe add `--toast-anchor-offset-top` or a page-level CSS container `.page-toasts { position: absolute; right: 24px; bottom: 24px; }` that pages can opt into.
Hector: If we move to a page container for toasts, ensure the container has `aria-live="polite"` and `role="status"` so screen readers announce message like "Removed 2 rules. Undo."
Rae: Keyboard notes: tab order should hit the checkbox, then row cells, then actions. The kebab must be a real `<button>` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and a screen reader label: "Actions for <row name>".
Mei: For menus we should portal them to body to avoid clipping; add focus-return logic when closed. Also use `role="menu"` and `role="menuitem"` for items.
QA: Quick usability plan: 6 rapid sessions to validate discoverability, toast overlap, and keyboard flow. If positive, land token + small toast anchor tweak.
design-bot: Figma frame updated: https://figma.com/file/xyz/compact-table-action-hits (frame: compact-hits-v2).
Hector: I'll file a tiny tokens PR: `tokens/space: add hitpad-compact-action` and add a CSS utility in components. Mei: can you add the toast container option to the table page stories in Storybook?
Mei: Yep — will add story and a11y checks. Rae: I'll schedule the hallway tests and add the accessibility checklist to the Figma file.
Rae: Goal: ship pragmatic fix this sprint (hitpad token + toast anchor) and iterate if hallway tests show edge cases. :thumbsup:
